messages:
maya: Heads-up: platform team wants a small API tweaka0introducing an "X-RW-ROUTE-POLICY" JSON header to encode routing policy (priority + quota_tag). They say it's optional but will override older headers. Thoughts on SDK impact?

eli: Optional is better, but TS/Python SDKs often normalize headers in middleware. We should avoid auto-parsing that could break users who send strings. Need backward compat plan.

harper: From Console POV we want quota_tag surfaced as "billing_group" in CSVs and dashboard tiles. We need canonical key names and a sample snippet in each SDK.

aditya: Implementation suggestion: add client option `routePolicy: { priority?: 'high'|'normal'|'low', quotaTag?: string }` to request-level options in SDKs. If not provided, SDKs keep writing legacy `X-RW-ROUTE` until deprecation window ends.

maya: Also propose a proxy shim that translates `X-RW-ROUTE` to `X-RW-ROUTE-POLICY` for compatibility during rollout. That buys time for older SDKs.

bryan: Metric team concern: free-form quota_tag will spike cardinality. We should validate tags (regex `^[a-z0-9\-_:]{1,64}$`) and map unknowns to `quota_tag:custom` for telemetry. Keep raw values in audit logs.

aditya: SDK helpers can perform validation and optionally bucket unknown tags. Suggest adding an opt-in `maskQuotaTag` flag.

je: Can we emit a deprecation warning header `X-RW-ROUTE-DEPRECATION: v1` while shim is active? Then we can monitor who still sends v1.

deploy-bot: shim-proxy deployed to canary-02 at 2026-03-20T10:30Z

harper: Console change: add "Show routing cost centers" boolean under Billing > Export options. When true, CSV includes `billing_group` column. We'll gate by customer opt-in.

eli: Tests: TS/Go should add unit tests to construct both headers and routePolicy object and assert header serialization. Integration test to ensure proxy shim picks up old header.

aditya: Timeline: proxy shim canary today, TS/Go PRs by next Tue, Python next Thu, docs + console toggle by next Fri. We'll keep old header accepted for 60 days after full rollout.

maya: Ok, action items: aditya open SDK PRs, bryan publish validation regex, harper wire console stub, eli write test plan. Sync Fri 9:30am. :calendar:
